subject: Return stay November 20–22, autumn boat and tea gathering

segments.text:
We loved our time at HOSHINOYA Kyoto and would like to come back. Could you please check availability for the following?

1. Stay:
Friday, November 20 to Sunday, November 22 (2 nights, 2 adults: Mia & Victor)
We saw that there is an extra 6:30 PM autumn leaves evening boat during the momiji season, and we would love to reserve it for two

, preferably on Friday, November 20, or on Saturday, November 21 if Friday is full.
3. Tea gathering:
We would also like to join the autumn leaves tea gathering at 3:00 PM on Saturday, November 21, if there are still two of the eight guest places available.
As before, please note that Victor prefers not to have raw shellfish.
Could you let us know the room rate, whether the boat and tea gathering can be confirmed, and the next step to complete the booking?
